data.name: Rajesh
data.gender_notes: Rajesh is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Lord of kings; ruler of kings
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit rāja, 'king', + īśa, 'lord' — 'lord of kings'. Its root is Sanskrit rāja + īśa. A classical Sanskrit name. Rajesh is a Sanskrit name meaning “Lord of kings; ruler of kings”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rajesh expresses “Lord of kings; ruler of kings”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit rāja, 'king', + īśa, 'lord' — 'lord of kings'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rajesh total 25, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.

vedic_reference.note: Rajesh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'rājaḥ', meaning 'king', and 'iṣaḥ', meaning 'lord'. This name is associated with the Vedic deity Indra, who is often referred to as the king of the gods (rājā devānām).
